name: Miyoo Mini series
identify: helperFunctions.sh: /proc/cpuinfo contains SStar (also the fallback); MINI_MODEL picks the model cfg, which sets SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME

keys.note: every button, the volume keys and POWER, polled; the same node on every model (MINI-NODE-MAP-COMPARISON-20261021.md)

lid.note: hall-mh248 on gpio35; spruce reads the lid through sysfs (hallvalue)

BOTTOM.cfg_differs: the cfg holds a placeholder (its own variable name), not a code; measured on the Miyoo Mini Flip  2026-11-11; the other models use the same soc:gpio_keys node, per-button codes not measured there
